every_position_composed.reason: Both sites use the exact same camera choreography across frames 1 through 9, keeping the 3D machinery in the right two-thirds and only slightly overlapping the anchor rack corner with the card in frame 5.

explains_the_project.reason: While both share the same 3D factory metaphor, the darker floor in site 2 makes the diegetic 3D floor labels and colored routing lines in frames 5, 6, 7, and 8 much easier to read.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: In frames 1 through 9, site 1's lighter slate floor catches clear, grounded cast shadows beneath the press, anchor rack, and conveyor, whereas site 2's near-black floor swallows the shadows and blends the dark machinery into the ground.

type_and_layout.reason: Although the left-aligned cards and top bar are identical across frames 1 to 9, site 2's subdued dark floor grid avoids competing visually with the UI panels and makes in-scene labels like frame 8's '7 HOSTS' pop.

overall.reason: Between two nearly identical builds differing only in floor shader brightness, site 1 feels much more like a tangible, world-class 3D tabletop scene because the lit slate surface preserves grounding shadows and spatial depth around the dark machinery.
